role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 7 added the devanagari script filter, whose vowel signs / virama / anusvara are letters of the word)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang hi --script devanagari --stop "टॉम,टॉमने,टॉमको,टॉमका,टॉमकी,टॉमके,टॉमसे,मैरी,मैरीने,मैरीको,जॉन" --out hi_words.txt hin_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Devanagari letters and their combining marks; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the top 900 lines as its seed and downloads this full list on the user's request.
